sources.label: thGOLD product page (early access, no published contract)
Theo thBILL blacklistability precedent (pausable institutional design)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: thGOLD has no published token contract as of 2026-09-29, so no holder-transfer surface exists to review; the verdict is possible rather than no because Theo's live products are centrally administered with gated access (thBILL pauses transfers through an emergency role under a timelock, and thUSD mints and redeems through a whitelist), making transfer or access controls likely once thGOLD deploys. The verdict will be re-reviewed at launch against the deployed contract.
